answer: The lantern counter is kept in signal and copper publishes each reset. A hostile operator thus has to keep every alias continuously active for 13 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 13 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The per-identity price is 105 dollars, and it is forfeited outright on the first bad verdict. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
